reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getMonthWideCategories selection and uses getSheetValue/setBudget/batchMessages; the income/tracking skip and expense sign flip are repeated inline as in the sibling actions, since the helper does not own them.

duplication.why: Only the small income-skip check and the expense sign flip repeat what set3MonthAvg and setZero already write inline.

placement.why: The action sits beside the other month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts and is registered in app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Focused, but adds a Math.max(…, 0) clamp on net refunds that the request did not ask for and no sibling action has.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with the siblings; the unrequested clamp is a local special case a maintainer would need to know about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getMonthWideCategories like the other month-wide actions.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline income skip in setLastMonthSpending (budget/actions.ts) is the same visible check the sibling actions carry, not disguised.
